scope: Frozen helper v4 source and exact build/actual bounded fixture evidence. No schedule, reclamation, production code, proof profile, resource-cap, whole workload or final SH8 acceptance approval.
reasoning: Frame header, payload and optional authenticated digest are private. Only successful Input::next creates Some after unchanged original header/order/codec/size/digest/terminal-EOF validation.
Newly encoded and synthesized terminal frames use None. The matching-new-header regression establishes they do not inherit a trusted zero digest.

Output retains the same wire/decoded allowances and rewrites sequence/predecessor before comparing all50 header bytes. It lazily reuses only an admitted digest for exactly identical immutable bytes; every changed/new frame hashes the same domain/header/payload as before.
Private truncated_completion reproduces the original terminal-header/31-byte-digest prefix and refuses new/nonterminal frames. All actual old/new fixture outputs and sidecars match.
main.rs, index.rs, noun.rs, Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock are byte-identical to frozen v3. No runtime verifier, source input, serialization/profile contract or numeric cap changes.

validation.build: Original actual Rust1.89 test/release-build receipts replayed:10 unit tests passed, zero warnings, exact binary bound.
validation.fixture: Independently rehashed raw28 command streams, checked14 full old/new bounded certificate byte comparisons, canonical sidecars, unchanged positive result, exact old negative stderr and protected destinations. These are retained actual root executions, not new executions by reviewer.

prefix.scope: Read full observer source and replayed receipt/source bindings, stable closed descriptor/path metadata and actual first/last sample identities. Original root command compared every partial byte and scanned the complete original; this review did not repeat that full scan. Deletion requires separately reviewed plan/action, complete failure provenance and fresh quiescence; failed original status remains unchanged.

limitations: No numeric speedup is claimed. The same-cap full mutation construction still needs actual completion evidence.

The initial design checklist recommended an instrumentation counter; source-level lazy computation plus private immutable admission proves the redundant output hash is skipped, so no production/report API change or extra instrumentation is required.
Old v3 cases remain part of a failed suite. Any later successful case-level reuse or C2 construction reuse needs its independent new admission and fresh verification contract.
